# ABOUT THE CONFEDERATION [italic]One people, many suns.[/italic]
The [bold]Central Confederation of Africa[/bold] is the union of the nations of Africa, joined under one charter in the 2050s. It sat among the original core members of the United Nations when humanity first left Earth, and it has outlasted most of the others.
## A LONG ROAD For most of its history the Confederation was the junior partner. The great powers set the terms, and the long rivalries of the 22nd century left our economy in a slump that lasted generations. We do not hide that history. We remember it, and we learned from it.
## THE NYAME SECTOR - In the late 2170s the Confederation opened the [bold]Nyame Sector[/bold], beyond the Far Reach. - Its worlds were settled by Confederation families, worked by Confederation hands and financed by Confederation banks. - Within a few years the sector grew into an economic powerhouse, and the Confederation's fortunes turned with it.
## THE CCA DOLLAR By the mid 2180s the [bold]CCA dollar[/bold] stands close beside the Weyland-Yutani colony dollar in value. It is backed by real production, not by a company ledger, and it is accepted at this mission and at every Confederation-funded establishment.
## THE CONFEDERATION ON THE FRONTIER The Confederation now funds new settlements, refineries and clinics across the Neroid Sector. We come as partners and investors. Where the superpowers bring garrisons, we prefer to bring contracts.
- Founded: 2050s - Home worlds: Earth and the Nyame Sector - Currency: CCA dollar - Defence: Confederation forces hold the Nyame Sector; the mission keeps no troops on this colony
